mapper.select: SELECT a.*, buyer.name AS buyer_name, buyer.uscc AS buyer_uscc, seller.name AS seller_name, seller.uscc AS seller_uscc FROM schema_verify.financing_application a LEFT JOIN schema_graph.enterprise buyer ON buyer.id = a.buyer_enterprise_id LEFT JOIN schema_graph.enterprise seller ON seller.id = a.seller_enterprise_id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.*, buyer.name AS buyer_name, buyer.uscc AS buyer_uscc, seller.name AS seller_name, seller.uscc AS seller_uscc FROM schema_verify.financing_application a LEFT JOIN schema_graph.enterprise buyer ON buyer.id = a.buyer_enterprise_id LEFT JOIN schema_graph.enterprise seller ON seller.id = a.seller_enterprise_id WHERE a.app_no = #{appNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_verify.financing_application (app_no, enterprise_id, buyer_enterprise_id, seller_enterprise_id, business_type, financing_amount, submitted_by, status, current_handler, submitted_at, version) VALUES (#{appNo}, #{enterpriseId}, #{buyerEnterpriseId}, #{sellerEnterpriseId}, #{businessType}, #{financingAmount}, #{submittedBy}, #{status}, #{currentHandler}, #{submittedAt}, #{version})
mapper.select:
SELECT id AS enterpriseId, name, uscc, industry, legal_person AS legalPerson, address FROM schema_graph.enterprise
EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM schema_graph.supply_chain_relation r WHERE r.to_enterprise_id = enterprise.id )
AND (CAST(id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR uscc ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_graph.enterprise (name, uscc, industry, legal_person, address, data_source) VALUES (#{name}, #{uscc}, #{industry}, #{legalPerson}, #{address}, 'MANUAL')
mapper.update: UPDATE schema_graph.enterprise SET name=#{name}, uscc=#{uscc}, industry=#{industry}, legal_person=#{legalPerson}, address=#{address}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=#{enterpriseId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_graph.supply_chain_relation (from_enterprise_id, to_enterprise_id, relation_type) VALUES (#{buyerEnterpriseId}, #{sellerEnterpriseId}, 'TRADE')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schema_graph.enterprise WHERE id = #{enterpriseId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schema_graph.supply_chain_relation WHERE (from_enterprise_id = #{buyerEnterpriseId} AND to_enterprise_id = #{sellerEnterpriseId}) OR (from_enterprise_id = #{sellerEnterpriseId} AND to_enterprise_id = #{buyerEnterpriseId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_verify.application_status_history (application_id, from_status, to_status, operator_id, remark) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{operatorId}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_verify.application_status_history WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC

SELECT m.*, f.file_name, f.file_type, f.file_size, t.template_code AS ocr_template_code, t.template_name AS ocr_template_name FROM schema_verify.application_material m JOIN schema_common.file_object f ON f.id = m.file_object_id LEFT JOIN schema_verify.ocr_recognition_template t ON t.id = m.ocr_template_id WHERE m.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT m.*, f.file_name, f.file_type, f.file_size, t.template_code AS ocr_template_code, t.template_name AS ocr_template_name FROM schema_verify.application_material m JOIN schema_common.file_object f ON f.id = m.file_object_id LEFT JOIN schema_verify.ocr_recognition_template t ON t.id = m.ocr_template_id WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_verify.application_material (application_id, file_object_id, ocr_template_id, material_type, identified_by, confidence, status) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{fileObjectId}, #{ocrTemplateId}, #{materialType}, #{identifiedBy}, #{confidence}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_verify.material_recognition_result WHERE application_material_id = #{applicationMaterialId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM schema_verify.ocr_recognition_template WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT * FROM schema_verify.ocr_recognition_template WHERE material_type=#{materialType} AND enabled=TRUE AND (enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} OR enterprise_id IS NULL) ORDER BY CASE WHEN enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, priority DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_verify.ocr_recognition_template(template_code,template_name,material_type,enterprise_id,priority,enabled,match_anchors,field_rules) VALUES(#{templateCode},#{templateName},#{materialType},#{enterpriseId},#{priority},#{enabled}, CAST(#{matchAnchors,typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), CAST(#{fieldRules,typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb))

INSERT INTO schema_verify.material_recognition_result (application_material_id, buyer_name, buyer_uscc, seller_name, seller_uscc, commodity, amount, amount_in_words, contract_date, order_date, invoice_date, logistics_date, acceptance_date, payment_date, contract_period, payment_term, transaction_no, field_confidence, raw_ocr_result, field_positions) VALUES (#{applicationMaterialId}, #{buyerName}, #{buyerUscc}, #{sellerName}, #{sellerUscc}, #{commodity}, #{amount}, #{amountInWords}, #{contractDate}, #{orderDate}, #{invoiceDate}, #{logisticsDate}, #{acceptanceDate}, #{paymentDate}, #{contractPeriod}, #{paymentTerm}, #{transactionNo}, CAST(#{fieldConfidence, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb), CAST(#{rawOcrResult, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb), CAST(#{fieldPositions, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE schema_verify.material_recognition_result SET buyer_name = #{buyerName}, buyer_uscc = #{buyerUscc}, seller_name = #{sellerName}, seller_uscc = #{sellerUscc}, commodity = #{commodity}, amount = #{amount}, amount_in_words = #{amountInWords}, contract_date = #{contractDate}, order_date = #{orderDate}, invoice_date = #{invoiceDate}, logistics_date = #{logisticsDate}, acceptance_date = #{acceptanceDate}, payment_date = #{paymentDate}, contract_period = #{contractPeriod}, payment_term = #{paymentTerm}, transaction_no = #{transactionNo}, field_confidence = CAST(#{fieldConfidence, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb), raw_ocr_result = CAST(#{rawOcrResult, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb), field_positions = CAST(#{fieldPositions, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_verify.verify_check_result WHERE application_id = #{applicationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_verify.verify_check_result (application_id, check_type, result, details, executed_rules) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{checkType}, #{result}, CAST(#{details, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb), CAST(#{executedRules, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_verify.verify_report WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM schema_verify.verify_report WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM schema_verify.verify_report WHERE report_no = #{reportNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_verify.verify_report (report_no, application_id, version, overall_assessment, abnormal_count, risk_hints, content_snapshot, content_hash) VALUES (#{reportNo}, #{applicationId}, #{version}, #{overallAssessment}, #{abnormalCount}, CAST(#{riskHints, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), CAST(#{contentSnapshot, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonMapTypeHandler} AS jsonb), #{contentHash})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schema_verify.financing_application WHERE enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND business_type = #{businessType} AND status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT a.*, buyer.name AS buyer_name, buyer.uscc AS buyer_uscc, seller.name AS seller_name, seller.uscc AS seller_uscc FROM schema_verify.financing_application a LEFT JOIN schema_graph.enterprise buyer ON buyer.id = a.buyer_enterprise_id LEFT JOIN schema_graph.enterprise seller ON seller.id = a.seller_enterprise_id WHERE a.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND a.business_type = #{businessType} AND a.status = 'APPROVED' AND a.id != #{excludeApplicationId} ORDER BY a.approved_at DESC, a.id DESC
